title: AI Skills That Make You Unfireable
full_monologue: The 3 AI skills that will make you unfireable are prompt engineering, ethical AI, and AI collaboration. Prompt engineering lets you communicate with AI like a pro, turning vague ideas into clear results. Ethical AI ensures you understand bias and fairness, making you a trusted professional. AI collaboration means working with AI as a teammate, not a replacement. These skills are in high demand, and they’re here to stay. What AI skill are you mastering right now? Comment below.
